aboutText: Fluro Electrics provides comprehensive electrical services for homes and businesses in Heidelberg. Our experienced team offers everything from wiring and power installations to home automation and renewable energy solutions. We are committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring all work meets Australian safety standards.
servicesText: We offer a full spectrum of electrical services, including domestic and commercial installations, data cabling, and home automation. Our team is equipped to handle projects of any size, ensuring high-quality results every time.

services.title: Domestic Electrical Services
services.desc: Comprehensive home electrical solutions, including lighting, wiring, and safety upgrades for Heidelberg residents.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Services
services.desc: Tailored electrical services for businesses, from office fit-outs to industrial maintenance and compliance.

services.title: Home Automation
services.desc: Expert installation and programming of smart home systems, enhancing convenience and efficiency in Heidelberg homes.

services.title: Renewable Energy Solutions
services.desc: Design and installation of solar panels and energy systems to reduce costs and environmental impact.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Services
services.desc: Prompt response to electrical emergencies during business hours, ensuring safety and minimal disruption.

services.title: Data Cabling & TV
services.desc: Professional installation of data, phone, and TV outlets, meeting Australian standards for homes and offices.
